hints.title: Middle Element Fixation
hints.text: Fix the middle element j of the triplet and count candidate outer elements relative to nums[j].

hints.title: Frequency Tracking
hints.text: Maintain occurrences of elements to the left and to the right of the current middle index.

hints.title: Multiplicative Combination
hints.text: For each middle element, multiply the count of left matches by the count of right matches.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def countSpecialTriplets(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        if n < 3:
            return 0
        
        right_counts = Counter(nums)
        left_counts = Counter()
        
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            right_counts[x] -= 1
            target = 2 * x
            ans += left_counts[target] * right_counts[target]
            left_counts[x] += 1
            
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single linear pass with prefix and suffix frequency counting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive three-pointer loops require O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Streaming frequency maps provides O(1) lookups per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Center the search on index j and combine left and right counts multiplicatively.
